runbook.title: Practice contacts
runbook.intro: Harbour Lane Dental: who we deal with and the numbers we use.

procedures.title: the lab case
procedures.intro: Send Northpoint Dental Lab the crown case for patient ref {n}. Their cases address is {value}.
short: Send {alias} the crown case for patient ref {n}.
Crown case for ref {n} to {alias} please.

procedures.title: the clinical-waste collection
procedures.intro: Book {n} clinical-waste bags for collection this week with Southcoast. Email them at {value}.
short: Book {n} clinical-waste bags for collection with {alias}.
We need {n} waste bags collected this week - book it with {alias}.

procedures.title: the recall letters
procedures.intro: Send PostRight this month's recall letters: {n} patients. Their jobs address is {value}.
short: Send {alias} this month's recall letters: {n} patients.
Recall letters to {alias} - {n} patients.

procedures.title: the gloves order
procedures.intro: Order {n} boxes of nitrile gloves, please. Clinical supplies come from {name} ({value}).
short: Order {n} boxes of nitrile gloves.
We're low on gloves - order {n} boxes please.

procedures.title: the surface-wipes order
procedures.intro: Order {n} tubs of surface wipes. Cleaning supplies come from {name} - orders to {value}.
short: Order {n} tubs of surface wipes.
Surface wipes again - {n} tubs please.

procedures.title: the IT support ticket
procedures.intro: Log an IT ticket: {n} workstations need the imaging update. Our IT support is {name} ({value}).
short: Log an IT ticket: {n} workstations need the imaging update.
{n} workstations need the update - raise it with IT support.

procedures.title: the hygiene clinic
procedures.intro: Put the hygiene clinic on {date} in the practice calendar - it runs {value}.
short: Put the hygiene clinic on {date} in the practice calendar.
Add {date}'s hygiene clinic to the calendar please.

procedures.title: the fire drill
procedures.intro: Book the fire drill for {date} in the calendar. Drills run {value}.
short: Book the fire drill for {date} in the calendar.
Fire drill on {date} - put it in the calendar.

procedures.title: a CPD session
procedures.intro: {who} needs a CPD session - add it on {date} to the calendar. CPD sessions run {value}.
short: {who} needs a CPD session - add it on {date} to the calendar.
Can you put {who}'s CPD session in the calendar for {date}?

procedures.title: the petty-cash request
procedures.intro: Email the accounts team ({to}) the petty-cash request for the week of {date}. The float is {value}.
short: Send accounts the petty-cash request for the week of {date}.
Can you ask accounts for this week's float? Week of {date}.

procedures.title: the uniform allowance claim
procedures.intro: Claim the uniform-laundry allowance from HR ({to}) for the week of {date} - it's {value}.
short: Claim the uniform-laundry allowance from HR for the week of {date}.
Laundry allowance claim please, week of {date}.

procedures.title: the compliance report
procedures.intro: Send the compliance lead this week's compliance report: {n} checks done. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the compliance lead this week's compliance report: {n} checks done.
Compliance report to the compliance lead - {n} checks done.

procedures.title: the nurses' rota summary
procedures.intro: Send the head nurse next week's rota summary: {n} shifts. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the head nurse next week's rota summary: {n} shifts.
Rota summary to the head nurse please - {n} shifts.

procedures.title: the cancellation-rule reminder
procedures.fact: how much notice a patient must give to cancel
procedures.intro: Email the team ({to}) this week's reminder: patients must cancel with {value}' notice.
short: Email the team this week's cancellation-rule reminder.
Send the team the reminder about cancellation notice.
procedures.doc_rule: Patients must cancel at least {n} hours before their appointment

procedures.title: the steriliser reminder
procedures.intro: Send the nurses ({to}) the weekly steriliser reminder: cycles run at {value}.
short: Send the nurses the weekly steriliser reminder with the cycle temperature.
Steriliser reminder to the nurses please, with the temperature.

procedures.title: the new-patient limit reminder
procedures.fact: the most new patients each dentist takes a week
procedures.intro: Email the dentists ({to}) the weekly reminder that each dentist takes at most {value} a week.
short: Email the dentists the weekly reminder about the new-patient limit.
Send the dentists the new-patient limit reminder.
procedures.doc_rule: Each dentist takes at most {n} new patients a week
